messages:
anna: Quick heads-up — planning a dry-run tonight 02:00 UTC for an engine swap (quant-kernel v4.2 -> v4.3) on staging then one small canary region. Goals: exercise rollback gating and deploybot hooks. @ops-oncall can you be available?

sam: I'm around, can join the dry-run. Any specific smoke metrics to watch?

maria: Watch qps, latency p50/p95, GPU mem OOMs, and kv-cache miss rate. I'll push a custom smoke set to canary.

sam: Got it. What's the rollback criteria? Need something short and actionable.

anna: Rollback matrix (short):
- immediate rollback if >=2% increase in request error rate vs baseline
- rollback if p95 latency increases >35% sustained for 2 minutes
- rollback on any kernel OOM / driver panic / coredump
- allow 10m hysteresis for transient spikes, but ops can override for manual rollback

maria: Add one more: if model eval perplexity regresses >1.5x on the dev prompt set -> rollback. I'll attach the eval set to the release notes.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] scheduled dry-run start=2026-03-22T02:00:00Z target=staging,canary image=quant-kernel:v4.3 flags=[staging-dryrun,true]

ops-oncall: I'll be on standby. Ping me in #eng-runtime 5m before start and post the canary host list.

anna: Preflight checklist:
- bake artifacts checksum: `sha256sum quant-kernel:v4.3` -> OK
- config: `engine.env.TRAFFIC_SLICE=0.02` for canary
- deploybot: enable `--quarantine-on-error` and `--smoke-timeout=300s`

sam: I'll run the preflight smoke after deploybot fires and post the short logs here.

maria: If we need to pin back, command is `deploybot pin engine quant-kernel:v4.2 --reason="rollback: smoke-fail"` — that will route traffic and trigger graceful STS drain.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] dry-run started on staging. logs: https://deploy.logs/5612347890/dryrun

sam: Smoke shows a small p95 blip at ~30s mark, looks stable otherwise. no OOMs.

maria: Eval set run started, will post final score in ~3m.

maria: Eval done — perplexity delta 1.1x, within tolerance. No quality regression.

anna: Looks green. We'll promote a tiny canary at 02:30 UTC (traffic 2%). If anything odd, manual rollback per matrix. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
